name: cio_delivery_spin_20261031
comment: ANCHOR: CIO_DELIVERY_SPIN_20261031 — tradeai-cio-delivery: list_notifications reads the outbox once (was once per stream, 201 s CPU on the real 7 MB file vs 0.12 s), every PENDING note is considered (the limit=50 hid older notes behind held advisories), overdue notes expire with a reason (expire() was called without one and the TypeError was swallowed), expiry cap from config/cio_delivery.json. Hermetic.
